items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: he had hired Maurice Purtle to play drums, they had put him under contract

ctx.x: Because this was when -- I wasn't ready, I talked to Glenn, and he said, 'Well, we're opening the at old Orchard Beach Glen Island Casino, so if we play a one nighter, we'll watch you' -- and I said 'Well, I'll be ready to play and I'll come out to see you.'
Well, I went out there, and he had hired Maurice Purtle to play drums, they had put him under contract -- he said he couldn't wait.
Yeah, we called him Moe Purtle.
